name: Beluna Grandsquall
description: A giant who liberates valuables from the world below, keeps a vault, and has pets that escape Stormkeld.

description_citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Wilds of Eldraine: card flavor text (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Indrelon is stolen and moved to Stormkeld; Will Kenrith abandons Ardenvale for Vantress and has wizards encase Wicked Slumber victims in glass caskets.
timeline.quote: Indrelon was stolen from Castle Vantress and moved to Beluna Grandsquall 's castle, Stormkeld.

citation.text: "Vantress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The giant Beluna's goose chases them and Beluna seizes Kellan, accusing them of trying to steal the mirror at her birthday party.
timeline.quote: "What are you doing at my party?"

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Lord Yorvo, apparently the Giant King, makes Kellan and his friends his guests and persuades Beluna to show them the mirror.
timeline.quote: "Consider you and yours my guests at this party."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Beluna habitually liberates valuables from the world below.
timeline.quote: Beluna makes a habit of "liberating" valuables from the world below, from priceless artifacts to historic buildings.

citation.text: Collector's Vault (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Gerra Grandsquall moves the mirror to Beluna Grandsquall's bedroom in Stormkeld.
timeline.quote: the mirror was moved by Gerra Grandsquall from Castle Vantress

citation.text: "Indrelon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A giant lady whose birthday party it is and who owns the goose Albiorix; she seizes Kellan.
